classes.name: ADOLC_TB_interface
classes.brief:
Pure C interface for tape-based ADOL-C

Provides C-callable functions for tape-based automatic differentiation
using opaque TBAdoubleHandle pointers. Enables use of ADOL-C from
languages without C++ FFI (Fortran, Python via ctypes, etc.).

**Categories:**
- create_tb_adouble/free_tb_adouble: Lifecycle management
- Arithmetic: add_tb_adouble, mult_tb_adouble, etc.
- Transcendental: tb_sin, tb_cos, tb_exp, tb_log, etc.
- Tape control: c_trace_on, c_trace_off
- Independent/dependent: create_independent, create_dependent

classes.name: ADOLC_TL_interface
classes.brief:
Pure C interface for traceless (tapeless) ADOL-C

Provides C-callable functions for traceless forward-mode automatic
differentiation using opaque TLAdoubleHandle pointers. Each adouble
carries derivative values for multiple directions.

**Categories:**
- create_tl_adouble/free_tl_adouble: Lifecycle management
- set_num_dir: Configure number of derivative directions
- Derivative access: get_tl_ad_values, set_tl_ad_value_idx
- Arithmetic: add_tl_adouble, mult_tl_adouble, etc.
- Transcendental: tl_sin, tl_cos, tl_exp, tl_log, etc.

classes.name: adalloc
classes.brief:
Multi-dimensional array allocation for ADOL-C

Provides memory allocation utilities for 1D, 2D, and 3D double arrays
used throughout ADOL-C for storing Taylor coefficients, Jacobians,
and intermediate values during tape evaluation.

**Key Functions:**
- myalloc1/2/3(): Allocate 1D/2D/3D double arrays
- myfree1/2/3(): Deallocate corresponding arrays
- myallocI2(): Allocate identity matrix representation

classes.name: adolc
classes.brief:
Master include file for ADOL-C automatic differentiation library

ADOL-C (Automatic Differentiation by Overloading in C++) computes derivatives
of mathematical functions via operator overloading and tape-based recording.
Records computation as a "tape" then replays in forward/reverse mode.

classes.name: adolc_all_in
classes.brief: Unified ADOL-C header for SWIG bindings

classes.name: adolc_openmp
adolc_sparse
classes.brief:
Convenience header for sparse derivative computation

Include this file to access all sparse derivative functionality:
- sparse_jac(): Sparse Jacobian computation
- sparse_hess(): Sparse Hessian computation
- jac_pat() / hess_pat(): Sparsity pattern detection
- Bit-pattern forward/reverse modes

classes.name: adolcerror
classes.brief:
ADOL-C error handling and exception framework

Defines the ADOLCError exception class and ErrorType enum for
structured error reporting with source location tracking.

**Key Components:**
- ADOLCError: Exception with file/line/function information
- ErrorType: Enumeration of all ADOL-C error categories
- CURRENT_LOCATION: Macro capturing source location
- fail(): Function to throw typed errors with context

classes.name: adolcexport
classes.brief:
DLL export/import macros for ADOL-C shared library builds

Defines the ADOLC_API macro for Windows DLL symbol visibility.
On Windows with ADOLC_SHARED defined, symbols are decorated with
dllexport (when building ADOL-C) or dllimport (when using ADOL-C).
On other platforms, ADOLC_API is empty.

classes.name: adoublecuda
classes.brief:
CUDA-enabled adouble class for GPU automatic differentiation

Provides an adouble implementation compatible with NVIDIA CUDA for
traceless forward-mode AD on GPUs. Supports single and multiple
directional derivatives with configurable NUMBER_DIRECTIONS.

**Features:**
- Device-callable operators and math functions
- Multi-direction derivative propagation
- Unified memory support with __managed__ variables

**Compilation:**
Define NUMBER_DIRECTIONS for vector mode, optionally DYNAMIC_DIRECTIONS
for runtime-configurable direction count.

classes.name: adtb_types
classes.brief:
Core AD types: adouble, pdouble, and tape_location

Defines the fundamental types for tape-based automatic differentiation:

- **adouble**: Active double that records operations on the tape.
  Use for variables whose derivatives you want to compute.

- **pdouble**: Parameter double for non-differentiable constants that
  can be changed without re-taping. Use for parameters you want to
  vary across multiple derivative evaluations.

- **tape_location<T>**: RAII wrapper managing tape location allocation
  and deallocation for adouble/pdouble.

classes.name: adtl
classes.brief:
Tape-less (traceless) forward-mode automatic differentiation

Provides the adtl::adouble class for direct forward-mode AD without
tape recording. Each adouble carries both its value and directional
derivatives, which are propagated immediately through operations.

classes.name: adtl_hov
classes.brief:
Higher-order vector traceless forward mode

Provides the adtl_hov::adouble class supporting traceless automatic
differentiation with higher-order Taylor coefficients in multiple
directions simultaneously. Configurable via setNumDir(), setDegree(),
and setMode().

**Modes:**
- ADTL_ZOS: Zero-order scalar (function value only)
- ADTL_FOV: First-order vector (Jacobian computation)
- ADTL_INDO: Index domain propagation (sparsity)
- ADTL_HOV: Higher-order vector (full Taylor coefficients)

classes.name: adtl_indo
classes.brief:
Traceless forward mode for Jacobian sparsity pattern detection

Provides a specialized adouble class (adtl_indo::adouble) that propagates
index sets instead of derivative values. Used to determine Jacobian
sparsity structure without computing actual derivatives.

**Key Functions:**
- ADOLC_Init_sparse_pattern(): Initialize input sparsity patterns
- ADOLC_get_sparse_pattern(): Extract output sparsity patterns
- ADOLC_get_sparse_jacobian(): Compute sparse Jacobian efficiently

classes.name: adubswigfuncs
classes.brief: SWIG operator overloads for badouble/adub types

classes.brief:
Legacy compatibility header (deprecated)

classes.brief:
Legacy compatibility header (deprecated)

classes.name: advector
classes.brief:
Traceable vector with differentiable subscript operations

Provides advector, a vector of adoubles that can trace subscripting
with adouble indices. This enables automatic differentiation through
array lookups where the index itself depends on independent variables.

**Key classes:**
- advector: Vector container with contiguous tape locations
- adubref: Reference type returned when indexing with adouble (lvalue case)

**Use case example:**
@code
advector table(n);        // Create table of adoubles
adouble index = ...;      // Index depends on independent variables
adouble result = table[index];  // Differentiation tracks index dependency
@endcode

@note This is only for taped (not tapeless) ADOL-C mode

classes.name: ampisupportAdolc
classes.brief:
AMPI (Adjoint MPI) tangent linear model support

Provides ADOLC_TLM_AMPI_* wrappers for MPI communication routines
that propagate derivative information through MPI calls during
tangent linear model evaluation.

**Supported Operations:**
- Point-to-point: Send, Recv, Isend, Irecv, Wait
- Collective: Barrier, Gather, Scatter, Allgather, Bcast
- Reduction: Reduce, Allreduce

@note Requires ADOLC_AMPI_SUPPORT and AMPI library

classes.name: array_handler
classes.brief:
Array index accessors for C interface

Provides C-callable functions for indexing into 1D, 2D, and 3D
arrays used by ADOL-C drivers. Enables languages without native
C multi-dimensional array support to access derivative results.

classes.name: buffer_temp
classes.brief:
Template buffer class for struct storage with linked sub-buffers

Provides Buffer<T, buff_size> template class that manages a linked list
of fixed-size arrays for efficient struct allocation. Used internally
by ADOL-C for external function descriptors and checkpointing data.

**Design:**
Buffers grow by allocating new SubBuffer nodes rather than reallocating,
avoiding pointer invalidation. Requires types with an `allmem` member
(enforced via AllMemType concept).

classes.name: checkpointing
classes.brief:
Checkpointing support for memory-efficient reverse mode AD

Implements checkpointing (also known as "time-stepping" or "revolve")
for computing adjoints of long time-stepping computations with bounded
memory. Instead of storing all intermediate states, only selected
"checkpoints" are stored, and segments are recomputed as needed.

classes.name: checkpointing_p
classes.brief:
Private/internal checkpointing utilities

Internal implementation details for ADOL-C's checkpointing (revolve)
system. Defines CP_BLOCK_SIZE and init_CpInfos for checkpoint buffer
management.

@note This is an internal header; use checkpointing.h for public API

classes.name: common
classes.brief:
Core ADOL-C type definitions and platform configuration

Provides fundamental type definitions (locint, revreal), platform
detection, memory allocation wrappers, and C/C++ interoperability
macros used throughout ADOL-C.

**Key Macros:**
- BEGIN_C_DECLS/END_C_DECLS: extern "C" wrappers
- MAXDEC/MINDEC: Safe max/min update macros
- ADOLC_MATH_NSP: Math function namespace

classes.name: convolut
classes.brief:
Convolution routines for higher-order reverse mode

Provides Taylor coefficient convolution operations for evaluating
higher-order derivatives during reverse mode tape interpretation.

**Key Operations:**
- conv/conv0: Standard convolution c = a * b (Taylor product)
- inconv/inconv0/inconv1: Incremental convolution c += a * b
- deconv/deconv0/deconv1: Decremental convolution c -= a * b
- divide, recipr: Division-related convolutions

These implement the chain rule for Taylor series at arbitrary order.

classes.name: driver_interface
classes.brief:
C interface for ADOL-C forward and reverse mode drivers

Provides C-callable wrappers for the overloaded C++ forward() and
reverse() functions with varying parameter combinations for:
- Zero-order (ZOS), first-order (FOS/FOV), higher-order (HOS/HOV)
- Scalar and vector modes
- With/without sparsity detection (nz arrays)

classes.name: drivers
classes.brief:
High-level driver functions for derivative computation

Provides convenient functions for computing common derivative quantities:
- gradient(): First derivative of scalar function (∇f)
- jacobian(): First derivative of vector function (∂F/∂x)
- hessian(): Second derivative of scalar function (∇²f)
- hess_vec(): Hessian-vector product (∇²f · v)
- jac_vec(): Jacobian-vector product (J · v)
- vec_jac(): Vector-Jacobian product (u^T · J)

These drivers wrap the lower-level forward/reverse interfaces and handle
memory allocation and mode selection automatically. All functions require
a pre-recorded tape (via trace_on/trace_off).

classes.name: drivers
classes.brief:
Lie derivative computation for nonlinear control systems

Computes Lie derivatives used in nonlinear control theory for:
- Observability analysis (lie_scalar, lie_gradient)
- Controllability analysis (lie_covector, lie_bracket)

**Mathematical background:**
Given vector field f(x) and scalar function h(x), the Lie derivative is:
  L_f h = ∇h · f = Σ (∂h/∂x_i) f_i(x)

Higher-order Lie derivatives (L_f^k h) reveal observability structure.
Lie brackets [f,g] = ∂g/∂x·f - ∂f/∂x·g reveal controllability structure.

**Functions:**
- lie_scalar(): Compute L_f^k h (scalar Lie derivatives)
- lie_gradient(): Compute ∇(L_f^k h) (gradients of Lie derivatives)
- lie_covector(): Compute covector fields
- lie_bracket(): Compute Lie bracket [f,g]

classes.name: dvlparms
classes.brief:
Developer/maintainer configuration parameters

Internal ADOL-C library-wide definitions for tape format versioning,
file naming, and system configuration. These parameters control
tape compatibility and file I/O behavior.

**Key Definitions:**
- ADOLC_NEW_TAPE_VERSION/SUBVERSION/PATCHLEVEL: Tape format version
- TAPE_DIR: Directory for tape files
- ADOLC_*_NAME: Tape file naming patterns
- statSpace: Statistics array size

@note Modifying these may break tape compatibility

classes.name: edfclasses
classes.brief:
Object-oriented interface for external differentiated functions

Provides C++ class-based wrappers for external functions with user-supplied
derivatives. Inherit from these base classes to integrate external code
(e.g., legacy Fortran, optimized BLAS, specialized solvers) into AD.

**Classes:**
- EDFobject: Basic external function with fixed array sizes
- EDFobject_iArr: External function with integer array parameters
- EDFobject_v2: Version 2 interface with variable-size arrays and context

**Required overrides:**
- function(): Evaluate the external function
- zos_forward(): Zero-order scalar (function evaluation during taping)
- fos_forward(): First-order scalar forward mode
- fov_forward(): First-order vector forward mode
- fos_reverse(): First-order scalar reverse mode
- fov_reverse(): First-order vector reverse mode

classes.name: externfcts
classes.brief:
Support for externally differentiated functions in ADOL-C tapes

Provides mechanisms to incorporate user-supplied derivative code for
functions that cannot or should not be traced (e.g., library calls,
specialized solvers, discontinuous functions). The user registers
callback functions for forward and reverse mode evaluation.

Use cases:
- Integrating external solvers (linear algebra, sparse systems)
- Hand-coded derivatives for performance-critical sections
- Functions from non-ADOL-C libraries
- Discontinuous or non-differentiable operations with custom handling

Callback modes:
- zos_forward: zero-order scalar (function evaluation only)
- fos_forward/fos_reverse: first-order scalar
- fov_forward/fov_reverse: first-order vector
- hos_forward/hos_reverse: higher-order scalar
- hov_forward/hov_reverse: higher-order vector

classes.name: externfcts2
classes.brief:
External differentiated functions API (version 2)

Provides interface for registering user-supplied derivative functions
for external code that cannot be traced by ADOL-C. Supports variable-
sized input/output arrays with forward and reverse mode callbacks.

**Workflow:**
1. Define derivative callbacks (zos_forward, fos_forward, fos_reverse, etc.)
2. Register with reg_ext_fct()
3. Call within traced code using call_ext_fct()

**Callback Types:**
- ADOLC_ext_fct_v2: Zero-order (function evaluation)
- ADOLC_ext_fct_v2_fos_forward: First-order scalar forward
- ADOLC_ext_fct_v2_fov_forward: First-order vector forward
- ADOLC_ext_fct_v2_fos_reverse: First-order scalar reverse
- ADOLC_ext_fct_v2_fov_reverse: First-order vector reverse

classes.name: fixpoint
classes.brief:
Differentiation through fixed-point iterations

Enables automatic differentiation of implicit functions defined as
fixed points x* = G(x*, u), where u are parameters.

**Problem:** Many numerical methods involve iterative solvers:
- Newton's method: x_{k+1} = x_k - f(x_k)/f'(x_k)
- Nonlinear system solvers
- Implicit time integrators

**Solution:** fp_iteration() differentiates through the converged result
without differentiating through all iteration steps, using the implicit
function theorem: dx

classes.name: fortutils
classes.brief:
Fortran array layout conversion utilities

Provides functions to convert between Fortran column-major and
C row-major array layouts for interoperability with Fortran code.

**Functions:**
- spread1/2/3(): Fortran → C (1D/2D/3D arrays)
- pack1/2/3(): C → Fortran (1D/2D/3D arrays)

Used by the Fortran-callable wrappers of ADOL-C drivers.

classes.name: globaltapevarscl
classes.brief:
Global tape variables for ADOL-C taping state

Defines GlobalTapeVarsCL class containing per-tape global state:
the `store` array holding adouble values, buffer size configurations,
parallel region flags, and StoreManager instances.

classes.name: interfaces
classes.brief:
Low-level forward and reverse mode interfaces for tape evaluation

Provides the core differentiation routines that evaluate recorded tapes
in forward mode (computing directional derivatives) and reverse mode
(computing adjoints/gradients). These are the building blocks used by
higher-level drivers like gradient() and hessian().

classes.name: matrixmemory
classes.brief: C-style multi-dimensional array allocation for SWIG

classes.name: medipacksupport
classes.brief:
MeDiPack integration for MPI-parallel automatic differentiation

Provides the AdolcTool class that integrates ADOL-C with MeDiPack for
differentiating MPI-parallel programs. Defines type mappings and
callbacks required by MeDiPack's adjoint MPI framework.

**Features:**
- Automatic adjoint communication handling
- Support for MPI collectives (reduce, gather, etc.)
- Primal value caching for reverse mode

@note Requires MeDiPack library and MPI

classes.name: medipacksupport_p
classes.brief:
Private MeDiPack callbacks for tape interpretation

Internal functions called during tape forward/reverse sweeps to
handle MeDiPack handle callbacks for MPI communication adjoints.

@note Internal header; use medipacksupport.h for public API

classes.name: odedrivers
classes.brief:
Taylor-based ODE integration drivers

Provides drivers for solving and differentiating ODEs of the form
x' = f(x) using Taylor series expansion. The tape records f(x),
then these drivers compute higher-order Taylor coefficients.

classes.name: oplate
classes.brief:
Operation tape opcode definitions

Defines the OPCODES enum containing all operation codes recorded
on ADOL-C tapes during tracing. Each opcode represents a primitive
operation (arithmetic, transcendental, control flow) that the tape
interpreter executes during forward/reverse sweeps.

**Opcode Categories:**
- Assignment: assign_ind, assign_dep, assign_a, assign_d
- Arithmetic: plus_a_a, mult_a_a, div_a_a, etc.
- Transcendental: exp_op, sin_op, log_op, etc.
- Conditional: cond_assign, eq_zero, lt_zero, etc.
- External: ext_diff, ext_diff_v2
- MPI (optional): ampi_send, ampi_recv, etc.

classes.name: persistanttapeinfos
classes.brief:
Persistent tape metadata surviving across tape re-use

Defines PersistantTapeInfos struct containing file names, solver state
(Jacobian solver, forward ODE solver), and keep flags that persist
when a tape is re-used rather than recreated.

classes.name: psdrivers
classes.brief:
Drivers for piecewise smooth (PS) functions with abs-normal form

Provides differentiation tools for functions containing absolute values
and other piecewise linear operations. These functions are not classically
differentiable at kink points, but have well-defined generalized derivatives.

classes.name: pydirectors
classes.brief: Python director classes for external differentiated functions

classes.name: pyedfclasses
classes.brief: Python wrapper classes for external differentiated functions

classes.name: revolve
classes.brief:
Optimal binomial checkpointing for memory-efficient reverse mode

Implements the revolve algorithm (Griewank & Walther) for optimal
checkpoint placement in reverse mode automatic differentiation.

classes.name: rpl_malloc
classes.brief:
Replacement malloc/realloc for non-GNU systems

Provides rpl_malloc, rpl_calloc, and rpl_realloc as fallbacks when
the system's malloc implementation is not GNU-compatible (e.g., on
some embedded systems or older Unix variants).

Only used internally when HAVE_MALLOC or HAVE_REALLOC are not set
during autoconf configuration.

@note Internal header; not for direct use

classes.name: sparse_fo_rev
classes.brief:
Bit-pattern propagation for sparsity detection

Provides forward and reverse mode interfaces that propagate bit patterns
instead of numerical values. Used to efficiently determine the sparsity
structure of Jacobian and Hessian matrices.

Bit patterns are packed into size_t words for efficiency. For n independent
variables, the seed matrix X[n][p] uses p = ceil(n / bits_per_long) words
per row, where bits_per_long = 8 * sizeof(size_t).

Two modes:
- **Tight**: Uses actual values x[] during propagation (more accurate)
- **Safe**: Uses only bit patterns (faster, may overestimate sparsity)

classes.name: sparsedrivers
classes.brief:
High-level drivers for sparse Jacobian and Hessian computation

Provides efficient computation of sparse derivatives by exploiting
sparsity structure using graph coloring and compressed computation.

classes.name: storemanager
classes.brief:
Variable location allocation for adouble values

Manages the global `store` array that holds adouble values during taping.
Implements efficient allocation/deallocation of tape location indices
using free-list algorithms inspired by Stroustrup's allocator pattern.

**Implementations:**
- StoreManager: Abstract base class
- StoreManagerLocint: Singleton location allocation with free list
- StoreManagerLocintBlock: Block allocation for contiguous locations

**Design Notes:**
StoreManagerLocintBlock supports allocating contiguous blocks for vector
operations while StoreManagerLocint is simpler for scalar-only use.
Both double the store size when exhausted.

classes.name: tape_interface
classes.brief:
Tape management interface for ADOL-C automatic differentiation

Provides functions for managing the "tape" - a recorded sequence of
operations that can be replayed in forward or reverse mode to compute
derivatives.

classes.name: tapedoc
classes.brief:
Tape documentation driver for debugging

Provides tape_doc() function that prints a human-readable description
of all operations recorded on a tape. Useful for debugging tape
structure and understanding what ADOL-C has recorded.

**Usage:**
```c
tape_doc(tag, m, n, x, y);  // Prints tape 'tag' operations to stdout
```

classes.name: tapeinfos
classes.brief:
Core tape state for operation/location/value buffers

Defines TapeInfos struct containing tape buffers (operations, locations,
values, Taylors), file handles, buffer pointers, statistics, and
low-level tape I/O operations.

Also defines SparseJacInfos/SparseHessInfos for ColPack integration.

classes.name: taylor
classes.brief:
Higher-order derivative tensors and implicit function differentiation

Provides drivers for computing higher-order derivative tensors and
differentiating through implicit/inverse functions.

classes.name: usrparms
classes.brief:
User-configurable ADOL-C performance parameters

Defines buffer sizes and constants that can be tuned for specific
applications. Larger buffers reduce file I/O but increase memory use.

**Buffer Sizes:**
- OBUFSIZE: Operation tape buffer (default 512KB)
- LBUFSIZE: Location tape buffer (default 512KB)
- VBUFSIZE: Value tape buffer (default 512KB)
- TBUFSIZE: Taylor coefficient buffer (default 512KB)
- TBUFNUM: Number of Taylor buffers (default 32)

**Other Settings:**
- fint/fdouble: Fortran interoperability types
- ADOLC_EPS: Zero tolerance for numerical tests
- ADOLC_CHECKUP/REPSUP: Checkpointing limits

classes.name: valuetape
classes.brief:
Central ValueTape class orchestrating ADOL-C tape management

Composes TapeInfos, GlobalTapeVarsCL, PersistantTapeInfos, and buffers
for checkpointing and external functions into a unified interface.
Provides methods for tape creation, forward/reverse sweep initialization,
Taylor coefficient management, and external function handling.

**Key Operations:**
- start_trace()/stop_trace(): Tape recording
- init_for_sweep()/init_rev_sweep(): Sweep initialization
- write_taylor()/get_taylor(): Taylor buffer management
- next_loc()/free_loc(): Variable location allocation
